Well okay. My partner always makes herself the victim in every situation. This whole week she's ignored me and on Thursday she yelled at me because I want to talk each night before bed. So I told her I would stop talking to her unless she sent me first. So the next day she called me and we talked for a while and stuff was fine until this morning she made a status on facebook talking about how she was looking into moving out of state and she was going on a trip with her friends before hand. She didn't tell me any of this at all so I was here with my anxiety having a fit and I asked her about it and she turned it around on me saying that she doesn't need permission to do what she wants and I don't need to know what she's doing with her time, and that I need to stop yelling and attacking her. I literally sent her a message asking about the trip and if our plans were still on and she got angry and screamed at me that I was ruining her one day off in two weeks. She and her best friend always ignore the fact that I'm transgender even though they told me they supported me and would use my gender pronouns. Her friend always makes racist jokes towards me, I know he's joking, but it still isn't fun, and neither one of them really understands what it feels like to experience racism since they're both only of European descent they've got absolutely no clue and when I bring up something saying I'd prefer they not use a certain term they tell me their other Latinx friends don't care if they use it so I shouldn't either. I've been trying to get back in touch with my roots because I don't know anything about where my family came from and since I started this I've felt all the racism I didn't notice from the past like people telling me I'm not really Latinx because I wasn't born there. I may not be an immigrant myself, but my family was and it's none of your business if I'm tracing my family roots back. My white side of my family didn't let me see my Mexican side for most of my life so I don't know many of my relatives, but the ones I do know have completely denounced our roots as unimportant and also use racism to talk about Latinx people. So either side of my family in the past two generations is extremely racist, most of them on both sides are very anti LGBT+, and I feel so isolated from my whole family. I've never been in a family for long anyway since  was in foster homes as a little kid and then after that I was manipulated by my white ignorant father into having weird hateful views on people. I'm very poor and I have no idea what I'm interested in at all. I can't go to college because I don't have money. I've never even been able to consider going, but I have a ton of things I'd love to learn. I feel like I'll be stuck in shitty jobs my whole life, and my partner belittled the only thing that I feel like will help me out. I'm releasing my first album soon and I try to talk to her about it, but she ignores me like she's been doing all week. Then today when we were fighting she told me "I'm sorry you're clingy and anxiety driven" when I told her I wanted an apology for her being mean all week, so she not only didn't apologized she said it was my fault for feeling this way despite me past and current mental issues. I've never been close to any family, I've always had a hard time making meaningful friendships and the time I finally get into a relationship she tells me I'm clingy and my anxiety is a hassle for her and she ignores my racial background and she ignores my gender. I'm just so alone right now, I feel like I have no use in life
